newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint closes firmer, yen futures active.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint closes firmer, yen futures active.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar on Monday in what dealers said was an average-to-quiet day of trading.
The forint closed at 156.10/15 to the dollar, right on the National Bank of Hungary bid, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit opened at 156.50/55 and had finished the morning trade at 156.40/45.
"It was an average day. It was following the dollar/mark," said Gabriella Szirtes of Budapest Bank.

On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) yen futures were the most actively traded, with the yen dropping for all trades for futures contracts. There were also trades for the three-month BUBOR and for ECU.
Prices declined for two maturities for the German mark, the dollar was stable apart from a drop of eight fillers for June, there was a slight drop for the ECU and sterling rose slightly.
Currency futures turnover on the BCE amounted to 1.391 billion forints.
